title: 82627Y0907-BWS Aquarius Software Support & Maintenance SS 7010188X
agency_path: City of New York > Environmental Protection
description_text:
Pursuant to Procurement Policy Board Rule Section 3-05, Department of Environmental Protection, intends to enter into a sole source agreement with Aquatic Informatics Inc for Aquarius software licenses.

This is a Notice of Intent. Please attach your authorized service letter from the manfacturer. 

All related inquiries should be sent via the Discussion Forum in PASSPort or to Noah Shieh at noahs@dep.nyc.gov, no later than November 6, 2026 by 2:00 P.M.
